description: This PHP source file generates a web page displaying software information about a network gateway device, including software versions, firmware name, model, and packet cable version. It includes external PHP files for header, utility functions, user interface components, navigation, and footer, and uses JavaScript for page initialization.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a given device information key.

methods.name: get_wan_type
methods.description: Determines the type of WAN connection (e.g., EPON).
